title: Riftn $RIFT Launch Status and the Legacy DHB Token
html:
$RIFT is Riftn’s in-app currency. The on-chain token has yet to launch and has no official contract address or exchange listing. You can already use it inside Riftn for eligible tips, content unlocks, rewards and Creator Studio.

Can I buy $RIFT in the UK?

There is no official exchange listing or contract address for the on-chain $RIFT token. Check the official launch status and join the launch list for an update.

What was DHB?

DHB was the legacy DeHub asset. Historical DHB contract addresses and market listings refer to that asset. The rebrand guide explains the announced migration plan for existing holders.

Can I use Riftn now?

Yes. Use Riftn on the web or get the Android or iPhone app. Using in-app $RIFT does not require trading an on-chain token.
